dedupe_keys.name: collaborative research seismic isolation of embedded foundations using periodic meta material barriers to create resilient structures

description: Collaborative Research: Seismic Isolation of Embedded Foundations Using Periodic Meta-material Barriers to Create Resilient Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by YI-LUNG MO, University of Houston (uh.edu). Evidence in recent severe earthquakes shows that conventional seismic isolation systems are effective in reducing the damage from horizontal components of earthquake shaking. However, conventional isolation systems are not well suited for protection against the vertical components of earthquake shaking, nor can they be readily used for embedded or underground structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Periodic Barrier, Seismic isolation, T-Rex, Thumper, Periodic Foundations.. Published 2022-09-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
